purpose: One line per must[] clause of every ACCEPTED epic, naming the artifact that makes it true. Created by the retroactive audit BLOCKED-100 required, and doubling as the standing artifact BLOCKED-101's third pre-flight question produces: a clause with no subject becomes a visible empty row rather than a question nobody asked.

method.question: Does this clause's subject exist in code? NOT whether it is correct or sufficiently tested -- those were signed off already.
method.readNotCount: A keyword hit is not evidence. P4-09's must[2] would have passed a careless grep: `detach` had 5 hits, in the right package, with the right word -- and every one was `detachInputSignal`, an event listener. Each row below was settled by reading the hit, and several probes that returned ZERO turned out to be wrong probes rather than missing subjects (P0-01 must[3], P0-07 must[0], P0-08 must[1], P1-07 must[1], P2-01 must[2]).
method.scope: 72 must[] clauses across 19 ACCEPTED epics. All 19 already have a non-empty acceptance-coverage entry per acceptance clause, verified mechanically.

findings.text: 外部 idempotency ledger 拒绝 stale epoch
findings.evidence: `idempotencyLedger` and `idempotency ledger` occur 0 times anywhere in packages/. What P4-07 delivers is `checkFencing`, which refuses a token whose epoch is not the item's current one -- a LEASE-level authority check. An idempotency ledger answers a different question: 'have I already applied this effect?'. The nearest thing in the repository is P4-06's message-bus dedup, which belongs to another epic and is not consulted here.
findings.whyItWasMissed: must[0], must[1] and must[2] are all lease/heartbeat/fencing and were built together; must[3] names a component OUTSIDE that cluster. No declared file pointed at it, so neither pre-flight question reached it -- exactly BLOCKED-101's blind spot, in an epic already ACCEPTED.
findings.status: P4-07 is ACCEPTED. Reported for a maintainer decision; not silently reopened.

findings.text: 将协议 schema 生成物纳入 release evidence 和 golden compatibility fixtures
findings.evidence: Two halves, both absent. RELEASE EVIDENCE: `schema` occurs 0 times in scripts/release/collect-evidence.mjs, so no protocol schema artifact enters an evidence package. GOLDEN FIXTURES: no fixture pins a fingerprint VALUE. The closest assertions are `computeSchemaFingerprint(surface) === computeSchemaFingerprint(surface)` and a /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/ shape check -- the first is a tautology that cannot fail, and neither can detect drift, which is the whole purpose of a golden fixture.
findings.secondaryFinding: The self-equality assertion is BLOCKED-098's shape: it executes, reports as covered, and can never distinguish any two implementations.
findings.status: P8-01 is ACCEPTED. Reported for a maintainer decision.

notAudited.acceptanceClauses: Every acceptance clause of all 19 has a non-empty acceptance-coverage entry citing frozen, verified cases; completeness was checked mechanically rather than re-read.
